verdict.rationale: There is a dedicated docs page titled "Webhooks" indicating Hatchet supports webhook functionality, but no detail is given on whether this covers subscribing to Hatchet's own workflow/task events (vs. using webhooks as workflow triggers), and no independent confirmation of this specific direction. missing for 10: description of webhook event subscription semantics, example payloads/config, and community/hands-on confirmation of outbound event webhooks.
